description: The profile page, and the gate in front of the whole app. A user cannot reach any signed-in route until profileComplete is true, and profileComplete becomes true when a signature image is on file — because the signature is stamped onto the printed request form and onto every approval. Uploads move from Cloudinary to S3.

happy_path.result: _authenticated redirects to /profile and the page shows the setup wording, not the normal profile header

happy_path.action: fills name, position (USER only) and drops a signature image
happy_path.result: the file is parked as a pending upload; nothing has touched S3 yet
the pending file is flushed to S3, the returned key replaces the object URL, profile.updateMyProfile persists it, profileComplete flips to true
to getDefaultRoute(role) — /requests for a USER, /staff/dashboard for staff, /admin for an admin
profile header, editable form, change-password card and the signature panel with the current image

alternate_paths.result: allowed — position is required for USER only, and Save changes must stay enabled after a signature upload with position blank (an explicit IRMS-old bug fix)

alternate_paths.result: the new URL replaces the old on save; the old object is left for the sweep, never deleted inline

alternate_paths.result: the mutation never runs, the form stays dirty, and an error toast names the failure — no record is saved carrying a blob: URL

hooks.note: Wrapped in useUploadingSubmit so the flush → rewrite → save → release order is not something a caller can get wrong.

functional: src/routes/_authenticated.tsx beforeLoad redirects to /profile when the session user's profileComplete is false and the path does not already start with /profile.
profileComplete is derived on the server: true once signatureUrl is non-empty. The client never sends it.

The signature upload is deferred: useDeferredUpload('signatures') parks the file behind an object URL and useUploadingSubmit flushes it on save, so a signature somebody dropped and thought better of never reaches the bucket.
'signatures' is added to UPLOAD_FOLDERS so the key prefix exists and the sweep can select on it.
src/lib/image-urls.ts reports user.signatureUrl for every user, or the sweep will delete signatures out from under live accounts.
After a successful setup save the page redirects to getDefaultRoute(role); on a normal edit it stays put and shows a toast.
The session cookie cache is refreshed after the write, or profileComplete stays false in the browser for up to an hour and the user is bounced straight back to /profile.
Save changes is enabled whenever the form is dirty, including the case of a staff member who uploaded a signature and left position blank.
authorization: protectedProcedure on both procedures; both read and write ctx.user only, so there is no userId parameter to tamper with.
Any authenticated role may reach /profile — it is the one signed-in route with no role gate, and it must stay that way because it is where the redirect sends everyone.
signatureUrl is validated with storedImageUrl on the server, so a client that skipped the flush cannot persist a blob: URL.
ux: The setup state says what is missing and why ('your signature appears on the printed request form'), not just 'complete your profile'.
AppFileUpload shows real byte progress during the flush; a signature upload that appears instant and then fails on save is the worst version of this screen.
The current signature is visible above the dropzone, so replacing one is a deliberate act rather than a surprise.
The action bar carries 'Unsaved changes will be lost if you navigate away' next to the buttons, and both buttons are disabled when the form is clean.
An approver whose signature is missing sees the reason on the review page too (spec 011-014), not only when the server refuses.

acceptance_criteria.then: they are redirected to /profile and the setup wording is shown

acceptance_criteria.then: no upload request has been made

acceptance_criteria.then: 'Position is required' appears and no request is sent

acceptance_criteria.given: a DIRECTOR on /profile with position empty and a new signature
acceptance_criteria.then: the save succeeds and profileComplete becomes true

acceptance_criteria.given: a user who has just saved their signature
acceptance_criteria.then: they are not bounced back to /profile — the session cookie carries profileComplete true

acceptance_criteria.given: a DIRECTOR whose signatureUrl is null
acceptance_criteria.then: the call fails with the missing-signature message

edge_cases: The session cookie cache is the trap: without the disableCookieCache re-read and the forwarded set-cookie headers, profileComplete stays false in the browser for up to an hour and the user loops back to /profile after every save.
storedImageUrl must be on the SERVER's shape, not just the form's — a flush that never ran must fail at the boundary rather than save a record whose signature is permanently blank.

Replacing a signature orphans the old S3 object. Do not delete inline: an approval already stamped with that URL still renders it. Let s3:sweep handle it, and make sure image-urls.ts reports the CURRENT signature so the sweep never takes a live one.
position is optional for staff but the PDF's representative rows are keyed on position; a staff member with no position simply does not appear in those rows, which is correct.
The redirect guard must exempt /profile itself, or a user with profileComplete false redirects forever.
An ADMIN never approves anything, so their missing signature is harmless — do not add a signature requirement to the ADMIN path.
out_of_scope: Changing the email address — it is the auth identity and stays immutable.
Avatar / profile photo — the old app had none and nothing needs one.
Deleting an account — the template's DeleteAccountCard is not mounted on this page; account state is an admin action (spec 017).
The approve-time signature guards themselves — declared here, implemented in specs 011-014.
